resources.string: Pair devices, control your TV, transfer accounts and settings, and set up connections.
Open Ambient TV on both devices on the same network. Pair them once to use playback and remote control. Select a paired device to connect.
Paired devices can connect while Ambient TV is open.
Send accounts, settings or menu sounds; the receiving device confirms the import.
Keep the TV reachable in the background, and set VPN, port and Wake-on-LAN per device.
Device connection: select a paired device. Apply changes here with “Save connection”.
